definitions.gloss: traffic lane; lane on a road
definitions.explanation: A marked division of a road for a single line of traffic. Used when talking about highways, multi-lane roads, and driving.

examples.japanese: ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{車線|しゃせん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{移|うつ}った→移る：01232_utsuru⟧。
examples.english: I moved to the right lane.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{片側|かたがわ}→片側：20150_katagawa⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{車線|しゃせん}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: This road has three lanes on each side.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧{車線|しゃせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: One lane is restricted due to construction.

notes:
{車線|しゃせん} refers to a marked lane on a road for a single line of traffic. Composed of ⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧ (vehicle) + ⟦{線|せん}→線：09901_sen⟧ (line).

COUNTING PATTERNS:
Used as a counter-like word to describe the number of lanes:
- ⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{車線|しゃせん} (two lanes)
- ⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧{車線|しゃせん} (three lanes)
- ⟦{片側|かたがわ}→片側：20150_katagawa⟧⟦{二|に}→二：00736_ni⟧{車線|しゃせん} (two lanes on each side)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {車線|しゃせん}⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧: lane change
- ⟦{追|お}い{越|こ}し→追い越す：04623_oikosu⟧{車線|しゃせん}: passing lane (right lane in Japan)
- {走行|そうこう}{車線|しゃせん}: driving lane (left lane in Japan)
- {車線|しゃせん}⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: lane restriction

USAGE:
Homophone: ⟦{斜線|しゃせん}→斜線：08120_shasen⟧ (diagonal line) uses different kanji and has a completely different meaning.
